difficulty.notes: 2.2 MB minified index.js (everything on line 154). The anchor is the login regenerator state machine that assembles the payload and writes the encrypted password field; it calls the page's encrypt helper (0.7), which wraps a JSEncrypt instance (v) bound with the site public key. JSEncrypt primitive is a separate vendor file. wasm/ + turing.captcha are device/captcha noise. phone/countryCode/password all go through the same encrypt helper.

task_contract.anchor_definition: The login function (regenerator state-machine body) that assembles the request payload and writes the RSA-encrypted password field before POSTing; it is the complete function containing the captured 1.json code. The per-field encrypt helper is a nested target-specific helper (0.7); JSEncrypt/RSAEncrypt are core utilities.

behavior_category.subtype: phone/countryCode/password each RSA-encrypted into the login payload
behavior_category.recompute_check: JSEncrypt RSA uses PKCS#1 random padding; not reproducible to a fixed value

near_categories.why_not: Multiple payload fields are transformed (not a single signature/token field), so this is request_transformation.
The values are RSA of user input, not a local UI-state encoding.
